text:
Arona — The sea in the dark
You landed late and heard the sea before you saw it; something in your chest loosened at the sound.
What happened · what you felt.

Arona — Black sand and a bakery
The bakery by the roundabout, the black sand too hot by eleven, both kids in the water until their lips went blue.
What happened.

Arona — Thinking about Monday
The drive north booked for tomorrow. Monday already in your head, and a tightness that came with it.
Tomorrow: the drive north.
What happened · what's ahead · what you felt.

Puerto de la Cruz — The couple who looked so sure
The story you told yourself about the couple at the next table: that they had it all worked out.
What you made of it.

Puerto de la Cruz — The pools and what they were for
The pools by the sea wall, and the thought that this is what the holiday is for: being near them while they are small.
You wondered whether you always tell it that way.
What happened · what you made of it · what matters.

Garachico — Heavy legs
Your legs heavy all day, and you did not mind it.
What you felt.

Garachico — Closing the laptop
You chose to close the laptop for the week, and pictured Monday going fine.
Tomorrow: back south by the coast.
What’s ahead · a choice.

Arona — Everything at once
The drive back, the sense the week had a shape, what it might mean, the choice to stay off email, what matters about it, the quiet it left.
What happened · what’s ahead · what you made of it · a choice · what matters · what you felt.

Arona — Lizards and the first quiet
Your youngest laughing at the lizards, and how much that matters to you.
Tomorrow: walk up to the old town before it gets hot.
What matters · what you felt.
